errors.text_span: for two audio-language models, MMAU and MMAR, evaluated on three distinct models: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies MMAU and MMAR as the 'audio-language models' being evaluated. Based on the chart's structure, the items on the x-axis (Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni) are the models being tested, while the legend items (MMAU and MMAR) represent the two different evaluation benchmarks or conditions.
